title: Elements of Position
description: Working record of one geometric figure: a closed unit whose interior remains divisible; two operators (shear then bind) that never name an angle inside the step; an n-gon of diameter n. Five parts. Tables from the 24 September 2026 walk (h = 0.002, 200000 steps, 127 hits) and matching n-gon and bridge runs. Drawings read those tables.
